places.quote: I spent the following day roaming through the valley.
places.note: Unnamed in passage; identified by context as Chamonix valley.

places.quote: I stood beside the sources of the Arveiron, which take their rise in a glacier
places.note: Shelley's spelling; the Arveiron is a river rising from the Mer de Glace.

places.quote: I resolved to ascend to the summit of Montanvert.
places.note: Spelling as in text; modern name Montenvers.

places.quote: above it rose Mont Blanc, in awful majesty.
For some time I sat upon the rock that overlooks the sea of ice.
places.note: Descriptive phrase identifying the Mer de Glace glacier.
